title: Kerbside idling-scooter exhaust, 3-D LES: final numbers of the signed report (ESTIMATE / 推估)

conventions.central: P50 over 1,000 emission draws of ONE simulated red
conventions.low_high: P5 / F and P95 x F, F = flow factor and grid factor combined in log-quadrature, exp(sqrt(ln(f1)^2 + ln(f2)^2)) (factors listed per number); odour-share numbers carry the emission spread only
conventions.aboveReference: set from the numbers: 'yes' if central exceeds the reference, 'in-worst-case-only' if only high does, 'no' otherwise; only for references of matching averaging time ('not-comparable' otherwise)
conventions.CO: increment above the street's background, ppm
conventions.conversions: one red of W s adds mean x W/900 to a 15-min mean and mean x W/3600 to a 1-h mean
